skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the cultural, social, economic, and political aspects of English-speaking countries, particularly the UK and the US.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems related to cultural and business contexts.
Improve communication skills in a multicultural environment, including group work and presentations.
Work effectively in teams and individually, respecting diverse cultural perspectives.
Understand and apply ethical principles in business contexts across different cultures.
Conduct research and analyze case studies on cultural and business topics.
Understand the geographical, historical, and political factors that shape the cultures of English-speaking countries.
Analyze economic issues and their impact on society in English-speaking countries.
Understand the education systems and reforms in English-speaking countries.
Study social attitudes and identities in English-speaking countries.
